name: Glass Hearts
source:
Glass Hearts is a choice-driven Boys Love / Yaoi visual novel game that takes place in a psychiatric hospital. In the game you will play as Kai, a young man who has been admitted to The Long River Psychiatric Hospital. Make difficult choices that will affect everyone around you - for better or for worse. 

Remember that what you do and say matters, and sometimes helping one person means harming another.

[From [url=https://aedian-glair.itch.io/glasshearts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Glass Hearts》是一款以精神病院为舞台、通过选择推动剧情的BL视觉小说。你将扮演入住长河精神病院的年轻男子Kai，做出艰难的选择。这些选择会影响身边的每一个人——可能让情况好转，也可能令其恶化。

记住，你的一言一行都至关重要。有时，帮助一个人，就意味着伤害另一个人。

[摘自[url=https://aedian-glair.itch.io/glasshearts]itch.io[/url]]
